subject: 4WD Arduino Bluetooth car with yellow BO motors and HC-05 module
title: File:Bluetooth Arduino Car.jpg
author: shreyansh232
credit_line: Photo: shreyansh232, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (background removed)
notes: Arduino 4WD car with yellow BO gear motors and an HC-05 Bluetooth module on a wooden deck. Home-made build; the original was shot on a wood-textured surface and the photo cuts off the bottoms of the front wheels. CC BY-SA 4.0: credit and share-alike for edits.
modifications: Background removed (rembg isnet-general-use + u2net masks, closed-form alpha matting), floor area under the chassis removed, brown colour fringe on the tyre edges toned down, placed on pure white with an added soft contact shadow.
derivative_note: This edited version is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0, the same licence as the original.

subject: DIY DJI F450 Flame Wheel quadcopter
title: File:F450-DJI-Futaba.JPG
author: Alexey M.
credit_line: Photo: Alexey M., CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (background removed)
notes: Assembled DJI F450 Flame Wheel quadcopter on grass. The original photo also showed a Futaba transmitter and a phone; both were removed in this edited version. Low resolution: the original is only 1044x610 px, so it was NOT upscaled to 1600 px. It looks soft if shown large. CC BY-SA 4.0.
modifications: Background (grass) removed with rembg isnet-general-use + alpha matting; the Futaba transmitter, its strap and the phone were removed so only the quadcopter remains; placed on pure white with added soft contact shadows under the landing-gear feet.
derivative_note: This edited version is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0, the same licence as the original.
